queries.inventory: WITH clock AS (SELECT to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS observed_ist), brands AS (SELECT competitor, count(*)::int AS stored_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE price IS NOT NULL)::int AS nonnull_price_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE price>0)::int AS positive_price_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE matched_prayag_code IS NOT NULL AND match_status='matched')::int AS accepted_matched_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE effective_date IS NULL)::int AS undated_rows FROM competitor_prices GROUP BY competitor) SELECT clock.observed_ist,coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(brands) ORDER BY competitor),'[]'::jsonb) AS brand_inventory FROM clock LEFT JOIN brands ON TRUE GROUP BY clock.observed_ist
queries.scopes: WITH clock AS (SELECT to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS observed_ist), joined AS (SELECT cp.competitor,cp.price,cp.match_status,cp.matched_prayag_code,p.item_code,p.division,p.category,p.is_active FROM competitor_prices cp LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT p.item_code,p.division,p.category,p.is_active FROM catalog_products p WHERE regexp_replace(upper(regexp_replace(trim(cp.matched_prayag_code),'\s+','','g')),'\.0$','')=regexp_replace(upper(regexp_replace(trim(p.item_code),'\s+','','g')),'\.0$','') ORDER BY p.is_active DESC,(p.item_code=cp.matched_prayag_code) DESC,p.id DESC LIMIT 1) p ON TRUE), scopes AS (SELECT competitor,division,category,count(*)::int AS stored_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE price>0)::int AS positive_price_rows,count(DISTINCT item_code)::int AS distinct_catalogue_products,count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_active)::int AS active_catalogue_rows FROM joined GROUP BY competitor,division,category) SELECT clock.observed_ist,coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(scopes) ORDER BY competitor,division,category),'[]'::jsonb) AS scopes FROM clock LEFT JOIN scopes ON TRUE GROUP BY clock.observed_ist
queries.last-price: WITH clock AS (SELECT to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS observed_ist,(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS as_of), brands AS (SELECT DISTINCT competitor FROM competitor_prices), products AS (SELECT item_code FROM catalog_products,clock WHERE is_active=TRUE AND (discontinued_from IS NULL OR discontinued_from>as_of)), current_rows AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (competitor,matched_prayag_code) competitor,matched_prayag_code,price FROM competitor_prices,clock WHERE matched_prayag_code IS NOT NULL AND match_status='matched' AND effective_date IS NOT NULL AND effective_date<=as_of AND price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY competitor,matched_prayag_code,effective_date DESC,id DESC), usable AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.item_code,c.competitor FROM products p JOIN current_rows c ON regexp_replace(upper(regexp_replace(trim(c.matched_prayag_code),'\s+','','g')),'\.0$','')=regexp_replace(upper(regexp_replace(trim(p.item_code),'\s+','','g')),'\.0$','') WHERE c.price>0), counts AS (SELECT p.item_code,count(DISTINCT u.competitor)::int AS competitors,array_agg(DISTINCT u.competitor) FILTER(WHERE u.competitor IS NOT NULL) AS names FROM products p LEFT JOIN usable u USING(item_code) GROUP BY p.item_code), scenarios AS (SELECT b.competitor,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM usable u WHERE u.competitor=b.competitor) AS products_with_this_competitor,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM counts c WHERE competitors=1 AND b.competitor=ANY(names)) AS newly_without_any_competitor,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM counts c WHERE competitors=0 OR (competitors=1 AND b.competitor=ANY(names))) AS without_any_after_exclusion FROM brands b) SELECT clock.observed_ist,clock.as_of,(SELECT count(*) FROM products)::int AS active_in_force_products,(SELECT count(*) FROM counts WHERE competitors=0)::int AS already_without_any_competitor,coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(scenarios) ORDER BY competitor) FROM scenarios),'[]'::jsonb) AS scenarios FROM clock
